build_FUNSDDatasetBuilder: build a FUNSDDatasetBuilder instance to process the FUNSD dataset with a specified split and index range
retrieve_FUNSD_dataset: retrieve the FUNSD dataset by downloading and extracting it from Google Drive to a target path
populate_key_value_item: populate a DoclingDocument with key-value pairs from FUNSD annotation data using graph cells and links
iterate_FUNSD_dataset: iterate through FUNSD dataset images and yield DatasetRecord objects with ground truth documents
convert_bbox_FUNSD: convert a bounding box list or BoundingBox object to a BoundingBox instance for FUNSD annotations
